messages:
Mia (CS): quick check-in for Pioneer onboarding health. pulling p95/p99 by route + model and streaming vs non-stream for the last 72h. spotted an unusual tail on /chat non-stream p99. can ops take a look?

James (Infra): copying the snapshot (72h window, tenant: pioneer-prod). usage +11% w/w, spend +8%, 5xx ~0.7%. table: 

James (Infra): ```
Route    Model           Mode         p95   p99
/chat    redwood-medium  streaming    700ms 1.05s
/chat    redwood-medium  non-stream   1.25s 2.85s
/generate gpt-mini       streaming    430ms 820ms
/generate gpt-mini       non-stream   660ms 1.45s
/embeds  embed-x         sync         95ms  160ms
```

James (Infra): quick hypothesis: higher-than-normal long-prompt share (~1.3k avg tokens) -> KV cache cold miss rate increases, and non-stream requests accumulate more queued work leading to long tails. also saw bursty sync patterns hitting same worker. CS Bot fired a p99 alert yesterday at 03:12 UTC.

Alex (Platform): confirmed. tracing shows batching waits and queuing on non-stream path; streaming flushes first chunk so observed p99 is lower. default max_batch_ms seems to be letting big batches form under burst.

Mia (CS): proposed mitigations? who can flip what and ETA?

James (Infra): plan: enable KV sticky caching for pioneer-prod and reduce max_batch_ms from 25ms -> 10ms on their pool. estimate: change + smoke tests ~6 hours, then rollout. I'll prepare config diff.

Alex (Platform): I'll put a routing override to bias /chat to streaming redwood-medium for pioneer-prod as a canary 5% -> 50% rollout. also recommend enabling model quantization profile in staging for gpt-mini to reduce CPU on non-stream.

Sophia (AE): flagging renewal: Pioneer renewal in 6 weeks. can we include cost impact if this tail remains? want a short note for the exec deck.

James (Infra): cost delta quick calc: long tail p99 adds ~15% more compute per affected request, translates to ~7-9% monthly spend increase if unmitigated. I'll put numbers in the renewal note.

Mia (CS): action items: 
- James: enable KV sticky caching + reduce max_batch_ms (owner: James, ETA: EOD Fri).
- Alex: routing override to prefer streaming on /chat, start 5% canary (owner: Alex, ETA: tomorrow morning).
- Sophia: craft renewal health note + cost delta for exec deck (owner: Sophia, ETA: next Tue).
- Mia: schedule enablement session with Pioneer engineers and follow up on error-rate trend (owner: Mia, ETA: next Wed).

James (Infra): I'll post the config diff and rollback steps to #eng-runtime. sample command I'll run: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/run-config -d '{"tenant":"pioneer-prod","kv_cache":true,"max_batch_ms":10}'
```

Alex (Platform): ping me once canary is up, I'll tag traces with routing_decision and watch p99 + span durations. will also verify that streaming preference reduces tail without increasing cost materially.

CS Bot: Automated alert: p99 latency > 2s on /chat non-stream (triggered 2026-03-18T03:12:08Z).

Mia (CS): thanks. I'll update the onboarding board and mark this thread as the week's authoritative Pioneer health update. :thumbsup:

Sophia (AE): scheduling a quick renewal sync with Pioneer execs and including these latency mitigation steps in the deck.

James (Infra): follow-up note: after cache + batch tuning we expect non-stream /chat p99 to drop into ~1.1-1.4s range. will report back after canary metrics stabilise.

Mia (CS): great, closing the loop here and will re-open if we see any regression.
